weather.blurb: The last of the heat before Thursday. Take the evening walk, not the noon one.

air.blurb: Fine for most of us. If your lungs are touchy, take it a little easy.

lake.blurb: Comfortably full, but every dry week takes a little. Down a touch from last week.

pollen.note: Tree 4 · Grass 3 · Weed 4 · Elm, Ragweed, Grasses
pollen.blurb: Elm and ragweed and grasses are heavy today. Windows closed, meds early.

grid.blurb: A busy afternoon: demand near 82,800 megawatts, with 103,300 on hand.

sun.blurb: Daylight is under twelve hours now, and it keeps getting shorter.
